description: Whether Storage v2 holds custom metadata to its documented 8 KiB: WriteObject with 8191-byte and 8192-byte values under a one-byte key and with a 40,000-byte value, a GetObject of the 8192-byte one and an UpdateObject that replaces it with a 20,000-byte value. The 2026-11-15 live recording shows that Cloud Storage stores every one, as it does through JSON and XML, so gRPC applies only the local 40 KiB bound on encoded metadata.
